scope_reason: Rapaport ("Jogani Gallery Exudes a Passion for Colored Stones") and katerinaperez.com describe Jogani as a dealer (since 2006) of rare old-mine-cut loose diamonds and colored gems, now with a gallery in Silver Lake; YP lists Jogani Inc at 9777 Wilshire Blvd as Jewelers-Wholesale & Manufacturers. jogani.com currently redirects to a Sotheby's page (no own contact page).
